baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a LED tub light 308D1661P001. A light fitted inside a dryer or washing machine that switches on and off as the door opens and closes. It consists of a printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) populated with an LED, a lens, a lamp base, PVC sealing, an O-ring and a wiring harness. The LED tub light 308D1661P001 is assembled in Thailand using components sourced from China.

The LED printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), populated with a South Korean LED, lens, lamp base, wiring harness and PVC sealing and O-ring are produced in China. 

Final assembly in Thailand: assemble the lens with the O-ring; assemble the PCBA to the lamp base; assemble the harness (connect the wires with the plug and the light head); seal and test.

prediction.decisive_step: Production and SMT population of the LED PCBA and fabrication of all other components in China
prediction.reasoning: Consistent with CBP rulings N348066, N345862, and N350050, the LED PCBA imparts the essential character to an LED light fixture by serving as the light source and electronic core. Here, the PCBA (populated with a South Korean LED) and all other components (lens, base, harness, seals) are manufactured in China. The final operations in Thailand consist of simple assembly, sealing, and testing, which do not constitute a substantial transformation.
